name: Quill USD
oneLiner: USDQ is Quill's Liquity-v2 fork on Scroll, minted from user-set interest CDPs against wETH, wstETH, weETH, and SCR collateral.
collateral: wETH, wstETH, weETH, and SCR in overcollateralized CDP markets on Scroll
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized CDP with user-set interest rates and direct on-chain redemption for underlying collateral; Stability Pools absorb liquidations per collateral market

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Scroll block 34365654 on 2026-07-15, the sole current USDQ proxy 0xdb9e8f82d6d45fff803161f2a5f75543972b229a pointed to verified BoldToken implementation 0x4103155fb2dcf8b6138c8eb4be0542facc9a7523, with zero EIP-1967 admin and beacon slots, and authority 0xBe589551397d0F28255e429DDB478620b1C2f08a. The verified transfer and transferFrom routes call _requireValidRecipient, which rejects only the zero address and USDQ itself; neither is authority-restricted, and the implementation exposes no pause, freeze, blacklist, or dynamic recipient list. The source header's blacklist wording is not matched by its executable recipient check. burn(address,uint256) is restricted to the configured CollateralRegistry or registered BorrowerOperations, TroveManager, and StabilityPool settlement paths, not an issuer holder blacklist. Direct false cannot be asserted because QuillUUPSUpgradeable makes _authorizeUpgrade restricted: the AccessManager maps upgradeToAndCall to role 2 and the Quill Safe holds that role with a 300-second scheduled path. Possible is therefore bounded to mutable future implementation authority, not a confirmed current holder freeze. The issuer documentation index exposed no terms/legal, independent proof-of-reserves/transparency, or official source repository; archive and audit disclosures did not establish a different current holder-control surface.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 access review

oracleRisk.summary: Quill's four Scroll branches use Chainlink collateral feeds with 48-hour staleness bounds; a feed failure permanently shuts down the affected branch and retains its last good price rather than switching providers.

branchApplicability.rationale: Quill publishes separate active-contract sets for WETH, wstETH, weETH, and SCR. Each has its own price feed, MCR, Stability Pool, Trove Manager, shutdown state, and debt-redistribution path, so all four require separate branch records.

branches.label: Quill WETH branch
branches.summary: The live WETH branch uses Chainlink ETH/USD, liquidates Troves below 110% MCR, and offsets debt through its Stability Pool before redistributing any remainder.

feeds.path: Chainlink ETH/USD -> QuillSimplePriceFeed -> WETH Trove collateral ratio

branches.fallbackBehavior: A malformed, non-positive, unavailable, future-dated, or more than 48-hour-old Chainlink response permanently shuts down the WETH branch and makes its PriceFeed return the stored lastGoodPrice; no alternate provider is configured.

collateralParameters.note: Live TroveManager values at Scroll block 34360866; shutdownTime was zero.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Any caller can batch-liquidate eligible WETH Troves below the branch MCR. The Stability Pool offsets available debt and receives collateral; uncovered debt and collateral are redistributed to active Troves.
branches.backstop: The branch Stability Pool is the first loss-absorption path. Debt beyond available Stability Pool USDQ is redistributed with collateral across active Troves.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: Oracle failure or a branch TCR at the 110% shutdown ratio permanently disables new borrowing and switches valuation to lastGoodPrice. Shutdown enables urgent redemptions; liquidation debt not offset by the Stability Pool is redistributed.

branches.label: Quill wstETH branch
branches.summary: The live wstETH branch composes Chainlink wstETH/stETH exchange-rate and ETH/USD feeds, liquidates Troves below 120% MCR, and uses Stability Pool offset plus redistribution.

feeds.path: Chainlink wstETH/stETH exchange rate multiplied by Chainlink ETH/USD -> QuillCompositePriceFeed -> wstETH Trove collateral ratio

branches.fallbackBehavior: Failure or more than 48 hours of staleness in either Chainlink component permanently shuts down the wstETH branch and makes its PriceFeed return lastGoodPrice; no alternate provider is configured.

branches.label: Quill SCR branch
branches.summary: The SCR branch uses Chainlink SCR/USD and a 120% MCR, but its TroveManager has recorded a permanent shutdown since 2026-04-06 and therefore no longer permits new borrowing.

feeds.path: Chainlink SCR/USD -> QuillSimplePriceFeed -> SCR Trove collateral ratio

branches.fallbackBehavior: The SCR PriceFeed has no alternate provider and is designed to retain lastGoodPrice after oracle failure. Its TroveManager was already permanently shut down at the observation block, with shutdownTime 1775494874.

collateralParameters.note: Live TroveManager values at Scroll block 34360866; shutdownTime 1775494874 corresponds to 2026-04-06T17:01:14Z.

branches.liquidationMechanism: The branch's public batch-liquidation path offsets eligible SCR Trove debt against its Stability Pool and redistributes uncovered debt and collateral. New borrowing is disabled because the branch is shut down.
branches.backstop: The branch Stability Pool offsets available liquidation debt; uncovered debt and collateral are redistributed across remaining active Troves. After shutdown, USDQ holders can use urgent redemption against branch Troves.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: The SCR branch has been permanently shut down since 2026-04-06, disabling new borrowing and ordinary redemption routing while enabling urgent redemptions. Stability Pool offset and active-Trove redistribution remain the recorded liquidation waterfall.

reserveReview.rationale: The independent Liquity-v2 branch producer read all four configured Quill ActivePools on Scroll at one capture and normalized their current collateral values. Each row retains its LST, market, counterparty, liquidity, and smart-contract failure domains.

mintAuthority.summary: USDQ is minted when users borrow against overcollateralized CDPs (wETH/wstETH/weETH/SCR) in Quill's Liquity-v2/BOLD fork on Scroll; minting is restricted to registered branch contracts. The USDQ token and QuillAccessManager are UUPS proxies. ADMIN_ROLE of the AccessManager is held by a Gnosis Safe 1.4.1 (0x32fd58b8, 3-of-6, has a guard at 0x075233a1), making the system mutable but multisig-gated.

controls.label: Liquity-v2 BoldToken branch minters (BorrowerOperations/ActivePool/StabilityPool)
controls.capDescription: Branch minting is restricted to registered BorrowerOperations/ActivePool-style contracts with collateral-registry caps that Quill admin controls can update.
controls.evidence: At Scroll block 34053392: USDQ token (0xdb9e8f82d6d45fff803161f2a5f75543972b229a) is a UUPS proxy with implementation at 0x4103155fb2dcf8b6138c8eb4be0542facc9a7523 (code length 20084). No external proxy admin slot populated. Branch minting is restricted to registered BorrowerOperations/ActivePool-style contracts with collateral-registry caps.

ADMIN_ROLE (id=0) was granted to Safe 0x32fd58b8 at deployment (block 15218053); deployer revoked its own role at block 15218072 per on-chain transaction history.

controls.evidence: At Scroll block 34053392: getOwners() returned 6 addresses, slot3=6 (ownerCount), slot4=3 (threshold). masterCopy at slot0=0x29fcb43b46531bca003ddc8fcb67ffe91900c762 (VERSION=1.4.1). getModules() returned empty array. Guard storage slot=0x075233a13896b064f19eb3cdeaa2fb03e3457726 (contract with 2640-byte code). Fallback handler=0xfd0732dc9e303f09fcef3a7388ad10a83459ec99. The deployer EOA (0x9b8d3e60) is owner 6 but is not the sole ADMIN_ROLE holder in the AccessManager.

review.evidence: On-chain reads at Scroll block 34053392: USDQ token (0xdb9e8f82) is a UUPS proxy (implementation=0x4103155fb2dcf8b6138c8eb4be0542facc9a7523, no external proxy admin). QuillAccessManager proxy (0xBe589551) is also a UUPS proxy (impl=0x3e5462da8e6c3971d445d717c389a8bec036b719, 'QuillAccessManagerUpgradeable' per Scrollscan). ADMIN_ROLE (id=0) was granted via grantRole tx at Scroll block 15218053 to 0x32fd58b8c4d454ab585dea736b7d2b5929b6676c (the deployer revoked its own ADMIN_ROLE at block 15218072). The ADMIN is a Gnosis Safe 1.4.1 multisig (0x32fd58b8, 3-of-6, no modules, HAS a guard at 0x075233a1, fallback handler=0xfd0732dc). Owner 4 is the deployer EOA (0x9b8d3e60) who retains a Safe signer seat.
